summary: 47-year-old hiker collapsed with a suspected cardiac issue while hiking with a friend in the Beaver Creek Wildlife Area, about three miles up the Powerline Trail Loop; the friend performed CPR for over two hours but the subject never regained consciousness. About 15 Fremont SAR members hiked to the cell-phone-ping location, found the body off-trail at the bottom of a steep ravine, and carried it out overnight via technical litter uphaul, reaching the road near dawn.
location: Beaver Creek Wildlife Area, Powerline Trail Loop
notes: Subject identified as Daniel Edwards, 47. SAR dispatched Saturday; radio article published 2022-03-23 reporting he 'died over the weekend' -> 2022-03-19 (a Saturday). Coroner: cause pending autopsy, appeared natural. Fremont SAR member Kris Hegler's first-person account.
